title: 1488–1517 historical 1502: Bug 1921394 - Handle non-ASCII characters when sorting folders and comparing paths. r=mkmelin - Strings should be normalised to Unicode canonical composition form before being inserted into the database.   This will prevent mistakes when comparing strings containing non-ASCII characters. - Folders (that have no explicit ordering) should be ordered in a case-sensitive and locale-aware way.
